content: Qlty is the successor to Code Climate Quality. Official migration docs state the Code Climate coverage API was disabled 2025-07-18 and organizations are being migrated or disabled. Qlty CLI runs changed-file static-analysis plugins locally, while Qlty Cloud supplies code coverage, PR gates, comments, and hosted views. Official plugin docs list RuboCop, Brakeman, Reek, StandardRB, Semgrep, and many others.
